Lucie Pssn 
It seems Israel wants to make sure the person doesn't effectively start living in Israel before that status is approved. So for people waiting from abroad, entry as a normal visitor may be restricted while the application is being processed. 
 
Also the application has probably been handed in on the basis that the foreign partner is residing outside of israel, which can cause issues as well. If your partner application was submitted while you were abroad, the partner procedure expects you to obtain entry clearance as part of that procedure before entering Israel. 

I would advise against going back to Israel while you’re waiting for the partner visa to be approved. Even though you still have time left on your 3-month B/2 tourist visa, your circumstances have changed because you now have a pending partner visa application.
